WITH d25 AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM ub WHERE d = '2017-11-25'), d26 AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM ub WHERE d = '2017-11-26') SELECT ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT d26.user_id) / COUNT(DISTINCT d25.user_id), 4) AS retention_rate FROM d25 LEFT JOIN d26 ON d25.user_id = d26.user_id LIMIT 1000

WITH item_user_behavior AS (SELECT user_id, item_id, MAX(behavior_type = 'cart') AS has_cart, MAX(behavior_type = 'fav') AS has_fav, MAX(behavior_type = 'buy') AS has_buy FROM ub WHERE behavior_type IN ('fav', 'cart', 'buy') GROUP BY user_id, item_id) SELECT ROUND(SUM(has_buy) / COUNT(*), 4) AS buy_conversion_rate FROM item_user_behavior WHERE has_cart = 1 AND has_fav = 0 LIMIT 1000

WITH combo AS (SELECT user_id, item_id, MIN(CASE WHEN behavior_type = 'cart' THEN ts END) AS cart_ts, MIN(CASE WHEN behavior_type = 'buy' THEN ts END) AS buy_ts FROM ub WHERE behavior_type IN ('cart', 'buy') GROUP BY user_id, item_id HAVING NOT cart_ts IS NULL AND NOT buy_ts IS NULL AND buy_ts > cart_ts) SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN buy_ts - cart_ts <= 86400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 4) AS ratio FROM combo LIMIT 1000

WITH cart_first AS (SELECT user_id, item_id, MIN(ts) AS cart_ts FROM ub WHERE behavior_type = 'cart' GROUP BY user_id, item_id), buy_first AS (SELECT user_id, item_id, MIN(ts) AS buy_ts FROM ub WHERE behavior_type = 'buy' GROUP BY user_id, item_id), combo AS (SELECT c.user_id, c.item_id, c.cart_ts, b.buy_ts FROM cart_first AS c JOIN buy_first AS b ON c.user_id = b.user_id AND c.item_id = b.item_id WHERE b.buy_ts > c.cart_ts) SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN buy_ts - cart_ts <= 86400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 4) AS ratio FROM combo LIMIT 1000

WITH cart_users AS (SELECT user_id, MIN(ts) AS first_cart_ts FROM ub WHERE behavior_type = 'cart' GROUP BY user_id), cart_then_buy AS (SELECT DISTINCT c.user_id FROM cart_users AS c JOIN ub AS b ON b.user_id = c.user_id AND b.behavior_type = 'buy' AND b.ts > c.first_cart_ts) SELECT COUNT(*) AS cart_user_cnt, COUNT(cb.user_id) AS buy_after_cart_user_cnt, ROUND(COUNT(cb.user_id) / COUNT(*), 4) AS buy_after_cart_rate FROM cart_users AS c LEFT JOIN cart_then_buy AS cb ON c.user_id = cb.user_id LIMIT 1000

SELECT h, COUNT(CASE WHEN behavior_type = 'buy' THEN 1 END) AS buy_cnt, COUNT(CASE WHEN behavior_type = 'pv' THEN 1 END) AS pv_cnt, ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN behavior_type = 'buy' THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN behavior_type = 'pv' THEN 1 END), 0), 4) AS buy_conversion_rate FROM ub GROUP BY h ORDER BY buy_conversion_rate DESC LIMIT 1

WITH hourly AS (SELECT h, SUM(behavior_type = 'pv') AS pv_cnt, SUM(behavior_type = 'buy') AS buy_cnt FROM ub GROUP BY h) SELECT h, pv_cnt, buy_cnt, ROUND(buy_cnt / NULLIF(pv_cnt, 0), 4) AS buy_conversion_rate FROM hourly ORDER BY buy_conversion_rate DESC LIMIT 1

WITH active_1125 AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM ub WHERE d = '2017-11-25'), active_1126 AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM ub WHERE d = '2017-11-26') SELECT ROUND(COUNT(a1126.user_id) / COUNT(a1125.user_id), 4) AS next_day_retention_rate FROM active_1125 AS a1125 LEFT JOIN active_1126 AS a1126 ON a1125.user_id = a1126.user_id LIMIT 1000

WITH d25 AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM ub WHERE d = '2017-11-25'), d26 AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM ub WHERE d = '2017-11-26') SELECT ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT d26.user_id) / COUNT(DISTINCT d25.user_id), 4) AS next_day_retention_rate FROM d25 LEFT JOIN d26 ON d25.user_id = d26.user_id LIMIT 1000

WITH base AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM ub WHERE d = '2017-11-28'), retained AS (SELECT DISTINCT u.user_id FROM ub AS u JOIN base AS b ON u.user_id = b.user_id WHERE u.d = '2017-12-01') SELECT ROUND((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM retained) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM base), 4) AS retention_3d LIMIT 1000

WITH e AS (SELECT user_id, item_id, ts, behavior_type FROM ub WHERE behavior_type IN ('cart', 'buy')), ordered AS (SELECT user_id, item_id, ts, behavior_type, MAX(CASE WHEN behavior_type = 'cart' THEN ts END) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id, item_id ORDER BY ts, CASE WHEN behavior_type = 'buy' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS prev_cart_ts FROM e) SELECT ROUND(AVG(ts - prev_cart_ts <= 86400), 4) AS within_24h_ratio FROM ordered WHERE behavior_type = 'buy' AND NOT prev_cart_ts IS NULL LIMIT 1000

WITH first_cart AS (SELECT user_id, item_id, MIN(ts) AS cart_ts FROM ub WHERE behavior_type = 'cart' GROUP BY user_id, item_id), buy_events AS (SELECT user_id, item_id, ts AS buy_ts FROM ub WHERE behavior_type = 'buy'), paired AS (SELECT c.user_id, c.item_id, c.cart_ts, MIN(b.buy_ts) AS first_buy_after_cart FROM first_cart AS c JOIN buy_events AS b ON b.user_id = c.user_id AND b.item_id = c.item_id AND b.buy_ts > c.cart_ts GROUP BY c.user_id, c.item_id, c.cart_ts) SELECT ROUND(AVG(first_buy_after_cart - cart_ts <= 86400), 4) AS ratio FROM paired LIMIT 1000
